editing_notes:
Replicate the reference: VO + B-roll, 35 to 45 seconds. Bold yellow italic captions centred low, a few words at a time, exactly like the reference. One idea per line, each with its own visual. Every shot shows the product or the ritual. Tags: AFTER 3 NIGHTS · AFTER 3 WEEKS; "UNLIKE PILLS, TEAS & LAXATIVES". Claims: feel and look only (lighter, less heavy, flatter-looking, jeans fit), plus the one mechanism line in the script (approved by Jared). Never "world's first", never esophagus/detox/repair claims like the reference uses. Real product (Products tab) for every product shot. OFFER: confirm the Complete Castor Oil Kit (oil + wrap) deal + landing page with the client before launch. Doc: Brief H+S, tab #29.

MECHANISM ANIMATION (about 8 s, the two mechanism lines): ONE continuous 3D shot, concrete like Johnny's #156 skin-tag explainer. No magic glow: every step on screen has a physical cause.
1. Start zoomed in on the skin cross-section (shorter than before): golden droplets labelled "RICINOLEIC ACID" sink down through the skin layers.
2. The camera follows the droplets down and pulls back to show the intestine under the belly: swollen, with gas bubbles and a clump of food stuck inside. The droplets settle on its outer muscle layer (label: "GUT MUSCLES").
3. On "stimulates": the droplets click into small receptor sockets on the muscle with a tiny spark, and the muscle visibly contracts.
4. The contraction travels ring by ring down the intestine, pushing the gas bubbles and food along and out of frame. The tube goes from swollen to normal.
5. Pull out to the whole belly: the outline goes from round to flatter. Then cut to the wrap shot.

Voiceover: Confident, clear female voice, 30s to 40s, fast and informative like the reference (product-explainer energy). NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, it's boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: Mostly B-roll, no main talking creator (like the reference). Short real-looking UGC clips of 2 to 3 different women 35 to 55 doing the ritual (rolling oil on the belly, wrapping up, on the couch), plus macro and 3D shots. Problem aware: bloated and tired of pills, teas and laxatives.
